a: The resource name of the IAP protected resource. Name can have below resources: * organizations/{organization_id} * folders/{folder_id} * projects/{project_id} * projects/{project_id}/iap_web *…
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
Identity sources that IAP can use to authenticate the end user. Only one identity source can be configured.
Configuration for customers to opt in for the feature.
Configuration to allow HTTP OPTIONS calls to skip authorization. If undefined, IAP will not apply any special logic to OPTIONS requests.
Login page URI associated with the GCIP tenants. Typically, all resources within the same project share the same login page, though it could be overridden at the sub resource level.

GCIP tenant ids that are linked to the IAP resource. tenantIds could be a string beginning with a number character to indicate authenticating with GCIP tenant flow, or in the format of _ to indicate authenticating with…
OAuth 2.0 client ID used in the OAuth flow to generate an access token. If this field is set, you can skip obtaining the OAuth credentials in this.
OAuth secret paired with client ID.
Domain hint to send as hd=? parameter in OAuth request flow. Enables redirect to primary IDP by skipping Google's login screen.
List of client ids allowed to use IAP programmatically.
Reauth session lifetime, how long before a user has to reauthenticate again. A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, ending with 's'. Example: "3.5s".
Reauth method requested. The possible values are: * 'LOGIN': Prompts the user to log in again. * 'SECURE_KEY': User must use their secure key 2nd factor device.
How IAP determines the effective policy in cases of hierarchical policies. Policies are merged from higher in the hierarchy to lower in the hierarchy.
The workforce pool resources. Only one workforce pool is accepted.
The OAuth 2.0 client ID registered in the workforce identity federation OAuth 2.0 Server.
Input only. The OAuth 2.0 client secret created while registering the client ID.
The Domain value to set for cookies generated by IAP. This value is not validated by the API, but will be ignored at runtime if invalid.
The URI to be redirected to when access is denied.
Whether to generate a troubleshooting URL on access denied events to this application.
Whether to generate remediation token on access denied events to this application.
Whether the provided attribute propagation settings should be evaluated on user requests. If set to true, attributes returned from the expression will be propagated in the set output credentials.
Raw string CEL expression. Must return a list of attributes. A maximum of 45 attributes can be selected.
Which output credentials attributes selected by the CEL expression should be propagated in. All attributes will be fully duplicated in each selected output credential.
Audience claim set in the generated RCToken. This value is not validated by IAP.
List of CIDRs that this group applies to.
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
List of FQDNs that this group applies to.
The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
The region of the tunnel group. Must be the same as the network resources in the group.
